name: tetaue
description: tetaue — a pure functional SQL query language, built with Langium on bun/TypeScript. Inspired by futu2/teta and mikitori/moria.

scripts.check:examples: bun run src/cli.ts check examples/adults.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/orders.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/strings.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/report.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/joins.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/namespaced.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/selective.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/case.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/lpbirthday.tetaue && bun run src/cli.ts check examples/lib-project/main.tetaue
scripts.build:extension: bun run build:server && bun run build:client
scripts.package:extension: bun run build:extension && cd extension && bun run package
